name: Dispatcharr Stream Sort
description: Ranks streams already assigned to Dispatcharr channels using hard resolution tiers and configurable quality, M3U source, prefix/regex, and throughput scoring.
author: matrix2669

fields.label: Sorting model
fields.description: Dead/stale streams are demoted first. Resolution is a hard tier (2160p > 1440p > 1080p > 720p > 576p > 480p). Inside a resolution tier, bitrate, frame rate, M3U source, name rules, and cached throughput are added into one score.

fields.label: Channel scope
fields.description: Optional group/profile filters limit every action. Multiple values inside one filter are ORed; when both filters are set, a channel must match both.

fields.label: Channel group filter
fields.help_text: Optional exact Dispatcharr channel group names or IDs, separated by commas or new lines. Examples: Local, id:4. Empty means all groups. Uses the channel's effective group, including overrides.

fields.label: Channel profile filter
fields.help_text: Optional exact Dispatcharr channel profile names or IDs, separated by commas or new lines. Only enabled profile memberships are included. Empty means all profiles/channels.

fields.label: M3U source scores
fields.help_text: One source=score per line. Match by exact M3U account name or account ID (4=20 or id:4=20). Positive values promote; negative values demote. First matching rule wins.

fields.label: Stream name scoring rules
fields.default:
# Prefix=score. Prefix rules are case-insensitive and anchored to the start of the stream name.
US=20
GO=10
TUBI=0
PRIME=-10
ROKU=-20
fields.help_text: PREFIX=score creates a case-insensitive anchored prefix rule (for example US=20 or ROKU=-20). Advanced regex uses score::regex. All matching name rules are additive.

fields.label: Throughput cache TTL (minutes)
fields.help_text: Expired throughput probes become UNKNOWN and stop affecting score.

fields.label: Maximum throughput probes per minute
fields.help_text: Global start-rate cap. Default mirrors Stream-Mapparr and limits provider load.

fields.label: Per-source probe delay (seconds)
fields.help_text: Minimum delay before starting another probe from the same M3U source.

fields.label: Maximum streams per probe run
fields.help_text: 0 means all unique streams attached to channels inside the selected channel scope.

actions.label: Dry Run
actions.description: Calculate the proposed order for the selected channel scope without changing ChannelStream.order.

actions.label: Sort Streams
actions.description: Apply the calculated order to streams already assigned to channels inside the selected scope.

confirm.title: Apply stream ordering?
confirm.message: This changes ChannelStream.order only for the selected channel scope. It does not add or remove stream matches.

actions.label: Probe Throughput
actions.description: Start a background delivery-throughput probe for unique streams in the selected channel scope.

confirm.title: Probe assigned streams?
confirm.message: This opens provider stream connections for streams attached to channels inside the selected scope.

actions.label: Probe + Sort
actions.description: Probe streams in the selected channel scope, then apply ordering when probing completes.

confirm.title: Probe and sort streams?
confirm.message: This probes provider streams in the selected channel scope and then changes ChannelStream.order.
